{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers with valid age (age > 0)
converted_valid_age = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['customer_age'] > 0)]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

count_valid_converted = converted_valid_age.shape[0]

# Print both the mean and the count
print("Mean age of converted customers (valid age only):", mean_age_converted)
print("Number of converted customers with valid age:", count_valid_converted)"}
